title: Cancellation of the restricted homotopy counit comparisons
statement: Let f:X→Y be a scheme morphism [def-pc-scheme], V an open of Y, U=f⁻¹V, f₀=f|V, and I any homotopy complex on X. Use the common supplied family of derived categories and the additive tensor-pullback instances and left-derived counits ε chosen by exists_derivedPullbackComposition [lem-pc-ringed-spaces-derived-pullback-composition]. Write P=f_*h(I) [def-pc-ringed-spaces-derived-direct-image], rY and rX for exact open restriction [def-pc-derived-open-restriction-maps], a for the pinned derived adjunction [def-pc-t2-open-pinned-adjunction], c for the pinned pullback composition [def-pc-t2-open-pinned-composition], Qh for localization [def-weil-abstract-derived-category], kY and kX for mapDerivedCategoryFactorsh, v for the homotopy tensor adjunction counit at I [lem-pc-module-pullback-adjunction], and t for the homotopy tensor restriction comparison at P [def-pc-open-pinned-single-tensor-restriction-iso]. For each derived object E on Y, S(E) is the composite of Lf₀ applied to the inverse open comparison on Y at E, c(f₀,V.ι) at E, transport along f₀≫V.ι=U.ι≫f, inverse c(U.ι,f) at E, and the open comparison on X at Lf(E). The composite Lf₀.map(kY.inv(P)) ≫ S.hom(Qh P) ≫ rX.map(ε_f(P)) ≫ rX.map(Qh.map(v)) ≫ kX.hom(I) equals ε_f₀(rY_h(P)) ≫ Qh.map(t.inv(P) ≫ rX_h.map(v)). This assertion contains no derived-unit or derived-adjunction-counit term.

proof.text: Apply open_pinned_counit_homotopy_restriction to the homotopy direct image of I and the canonical restricted square. Apply the private categorical cancellation lemma: precompose by the inverse mapped source restriction factorization, cancel the localized tensor-restriction comparison, and use naturality of mapDerivedCategoryFactorsh at the homotopy tensor counit. The private remove_mapped_identity lemma proves the five-factor restricted coefficient with its final mapped identity equals the five-factor composite alone. Map this equality through the remaining composite and combine it with the cancellation equality by transitivity. Expand only the pinned composition/counit names and the isomorphism projections, then use functoriality and associativity to obtain the displayed equality. Constructed derived and homotopy functors are locally irreducible during elaboration to avoid expansion into sheaf-component maps.

proof_origin.place: Existing upstream SingleComplexOpenRestrictedCounitCancellation proof, re-exported by S8 after the 2026-10-20 synchronization; same categorical cancellation and naturality route.

theorem singleComplexOpen_restricted_counit_cancellation
    [∀ Y : Scheme.{u},
      HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))]
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (V : Y.Opens)
    (I : HomotopyCategory (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) (.up ℤ)) :
    let _ : ∀ {Y Z : Scheme.{u}} (k : Y ⟶ Z),
      (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback k).Additive :=
      @Classical.choose _ _ exists_derivedPullbackComposition
    let F := RingedSpace.moduleDirectImage f.toLRSHom.toShHom
    let F₀ := RingedSpace.moduleDirectImage (f ∣_ V).toLRSHom.toShHom
    let rY := schemeOpenRestriction Y V
    let rX := schemeOpenRestriction X (f ⁻¹ᵁ V)
    let a := @singleComplexOpenPinnedAdjunction.{u, w} _
    let c := @singleComplexOpenPinnedComposition.{u, w} _
    let ε := @Classical.choose _ _
      (Classical.choose_spec exists_derivedPullbackComposition)
    (derivedPullback (f ∣_ V)).map
      (rY.mapDerivedCategoryFactorsh.inv.app ((F.mapHomotopyCategory (.up ℤ)).obj I)) ≫
      ((derivedPullback (f ∣_ V)).mapIso
          ((singleComplexOpenPullbackIso Y V).symm.app
            (DerivedCategory.Qh.obj ((F.mapHomotopyCategory (.up ℤ)).obj I))) ≪≫
        (c (f ∣_ V) V.ι).app (DerivedCategory.Qh.obj ((F.mapHomotopyCategory (.up ℤ)).obj I)) ≪≫
        eqToIso (congrArg
          (fun k ↦ (derivedPullback k).obj
            (DerivedCategory.Qh.obj ((F.mapHomotopyCategory (.up ℤ)).obj I)))
          (morphismRestrict_ι f V)) ≪≫
        (c (f ⁻¹ᵁ V).ι f).symm.app
          (DerivedCategory.Qh.obj ((F.mapHomotopyCategory (.up ℤ)).obj I)) ≪≫
        (singleComplexOpenPullbackIso X (f ⁻¹ᵁ V)).app
          ((derivedPullback f).obj
            (DerivedCategory.Qh.obj ((F.mapHomotopyCategory (.up ℤ)).obj I)))).hom ≫
      rX.mapDerivedCategory.map ((ε f).app ((F.mapHomotopyCategory (.up ℤ)).obj I)) ≫
      rX.mapDerivedCategory.map (DerivedCategory.Qh.map
        (((Classical.choose (Scheme.Modules.exists_tensorPullbackAdjunction f))
          |>.mapHomotopyCategory (.up ℤ)).counit.app I)) ≫
      rX.mapDerivedCategoryFactorsh.hom.app I =
    (ε (f ∣_ V)).app ((rY.mapHomotopyCategory (.up ℤ)).obj
      ((F.mapHomotopyCategory (.up ℤ)).obj I)) ≫
      DerivedCategory.Qh.map
        ((openPinnedHomotopyTensorRestrictionIso f V (f ⁻¹ᵁ V) (f ∣_ V)
            (morphismRestrict_ι f V)).inv.app ((F.mapHomotopyCategory (.up ℤ)).obj I) ≫
          (rX.mapHomotopyCategory (.up ℤ)).map
            (((Classical.choose (Scheme.Modules.exists_tensorPullbackAdjunction f))
              |>.mapHomotopyCategory (.up ℤ)).counit.app I))
